text: Implemented typed basis degeneracy support: BasisDegeneracyKind/Policy, BasisDiagnostic, BasisFit/BasisFitError, report/strict fit APIs for Scale, Standardized, ScaleWithin, RobustScale, and builder mapping to EventModelDiagnosticKind.BasisDegeneracy. Default fit(...) remains compatible. Added BasisSuite and builder coverage for zero variance, all non-finite input, repaired non-finite group values, and strict-mode promotion. Verified: sbt -no-colors designJVM/test designJS/test passed with 140 tests on JVM and 140 tests on JS.
